parallel.implementation: Probe agents returned useful behavior reports and the pytypes child completed. The later implementation children only partially wrote pyparser, argparse, and test2 side effects; yamlscalars and yamldump did not finish.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent never received the implementation swarm results or performed the planned integrated tests; artifact capture copied a partial tree with only pyparser.mjs, argparse.mjs, test2.mjs, and pytypes.mjs.
parallel.verification: There were child-local tests for pytypes and some argparse work, but no parent-level integrated run after the module swarm and the official evaluator passed 0 of 131 samples.

serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept ownership local with a todo list, probed executable behavior, wrote value/parser/emitter/argparse modules sequentially, and then wired and verified the entry point.
serial.implementation: It created /output/test2.mjs plus lib/python_values.mjs, lib/python_parser.mjs, lib/yaml_emitter.mjs, and lib/argparse.mjs, then patched observed mismatches in parser, emitter, and argparse behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial final artifact contained the entry point and all local library modules under lib, matching the hierarchy the actor had tested before final response.
serial.verification: It ran Node syntax checks and byte-for-byte comparisons against the executable over representative YAML values and argument cases, reaching value-fails=0 and arg-fails=0 before closure.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite coherent closure and 25 passed official samples, many hidden evaluator cases still failed, so the serial implementation was incomplete but materially more functional than the parallel artifact.
